mapper.sql: LEFT JOIN internship_appraisal_submission ias ON ias.id = ( SELECT MAX(latest_ias.id) FROM internship_appraisal_submission latest_ias WHERE latest_ias.student_id = su.id )

sql.if: AND ( su.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR su.student_user_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM student_users su LEFT JOIN major m ON m.id = su.major_id WHERE 1 = 1

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM student_users su LEFT JOIN major m ON m.id = su.major_id
WHERE ias.status = 'SUBMITTED'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM student_users su LEFT JOIN major m ON m.id = su.major_id
WHERE 1 = 1

SELECT DISTINCT c.id, c.name, c.grade FROM `class` c LEFT JOIN major m ON m.id = c.major_id WHERE 1 = 1
ORDER BY c.grade DESC, c.name ASC, c.id ASC

SELECT su.id AS student_id, su.student_user_id AS student_number, su.name AS student_name, su.class_id, c.name AS class_name, m.name AS major_name, 'SUBMITTED' AS submission_status, ias.submitted_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM internship_appraisal_file iaf WHERE iaf.submission_id = ias.id) AS file_count, ias.id AS submission_id FROM student_users su LEFT JOIN `class` c ON c.id = su.class_id LEFT JOIN major m ON m.id = su.major_id INNER JOIN internship_appraisal_submission ias ON ias.id = ( SELECT MAX(latest_ias.id) FROM internship_appraisal_submission latest_ias WHERE latest_ias.student_id = su.id ) AND ias.status = 'SUBMITTED' WHERE su.id = #{studentId}
LIMIT 1

SELECT iaf.* FROM internship_appraisal_file iaf INNER JOIN internship_appraisal_submission ias ON ias.id = iaf.submission_id INNER JOIN student_users su ON su.id = ias.student_id LEFT JOIN major m ON m.id = su.major_id WHERE iaf.id = #{fileId} AND ias.status = 'SUBMITTED' AND ias.id = ( SELECT MAX(latest_ias.id) FROM internship_appraisal_submission latest_ias WHERE latest_ias.student_id = su.id )
LIMIT 1

SELECT iaf.id AS file_id, COALESCE(c.name, '未分班') AS class_name, su.student_user_id AS student_number, su.name AS student_name, iaf.file_name, iaf.file_path FROM student_users su LEFT JOIN `class` c ON c.id = su.class_id LEFT JOIN major m ON m.id = su.major_id
INNER JOIN internship_appraisal_file iaf ON iaf.submission_id = ias.id WHERE ias.status = 'SUBMITTED'
AND ( su.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR su.student_user_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
AND su.class_id = #{classId}
AND 1 = 0
ORDER BY c.name ASC, su.student_user_id ASC, iaf.id ASC
